exposure: low maternal pre-pregnancy body mass index
cohort: A total of 9130 live-born neonates and their mothers were recruited from 13 purposively selected hospitals across Sri Lanka.
finding: Teenage pregnancy, low maternal pre-pregnancy body mass index, inadequate weight gain during pregnancy, maternal anaemia at delivery, chronic lung disease, and pregnancy induced hypertension were identified as significant modifiable risk factors for small for gestational age.
birth_weight: All live-born neonates, with a mean birth weight of 2827g, and a focus on those with low birth weight (20.4%).
gest_age: All live-born neonates, including premature (10.9%) and small for gestational age (20.0%) infants.
